_comment: CDC Crossing Register — maintained by w-c2. Every known clock-domain crossing must be listed here. Unlisted crossings are invisible to this gate.
_audit_note: Does NOT prove completeness. Only listed crossings are checked.

crossings.justification: Gray-coded pointer through 2-FF chain (wr_gray_r1 → wr_gray_r2). Gray coding ensures at most 1 bit changes per clock, safe for 2-FF sync. Used for rd_empty detection.
Gray-coded pointer through 2-FF chain (rd_gray_w1 → rd_gray_w2). Used for wr_full/wr_almost_full detection.
Gray-coded after d86c183 fix. Was binary (CDC bug). Now safe: 2-FF sync on Gray pointers. Slow reader (48kHz) from fast writer (20MHz) — direction is safe for level sync.
Gray-coded after d86c183 fix. Fast reader (20MHz) from slow writer (48kHz). 2-FF sync.
1-bit level signal through 2-FF chain (has_wr_s1 → has_wr_s2). Single bit, level-stable. Safe.

crossings._status: FUTURE — only exists after w-a3 commit 60df5a2 merges (arbiter .clk → clk_ddr)
crossings.justification: UNPROTECTED. m1_dout_ready = DDRAM_DOUT_READY & rsp_active & rsp_owner_m1, produced combinationally from clk_ddr-domain registers. Single-cycle pulse at 90 MHz (11.1 ns) sampled by clk_sys at 20 MHz (50 ns). The slow-domain sampler can miss beats. Needs FIFO or pulse-stretch. Currently on feat/a3-frame-store, not merged to main.
UNPROTECTED after 60df5a2. Same pattern as m1_dout_ready. present_core samples this on clk_sys. However, ddr_frame_store may have its own synchronization — needs verification by w-a3.
F2SDRAM command/response interface uses Intel-provided async FIFOs inside the HPS hard IP. The sysmem_lite wrapper handles CDC internally. SDC has set_clock_groups -exclusive between these PLLs.
